name: Forever Held
source:
Your two best friends are getting married, and you've been a horrible bridesmaid. Can you be honest before it's too late?

[From [url=https://minute.itch.io/forever-held]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的两位挚友即将步入婚姻殿堂，而你却当了一名糟糕透顶的伴娘。在一切无可挽回之前，你能否鼓起勇气坦白真心？

[摘自[url=https://minute.itch.io/forever-held]itch.io[/url]]
